J1: app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL:90: garbled text after the SPACE parameter on the STMTFILE DD of STEP040 (stray '00,RECFM=FB), ATA.VSAM.KSDS'). It follows a blank so it is comment text on a continuation line; DSN is on line 91. STEP040 runs in-scope CBSTM03A so no step data edge is emitted anyway.

J1: app/jcl/CBADMCDJ.jcl:27: STEP1 PGM=DFHCSDUP with PARM='CSD(READWRITE),PAGESIZE(60),NOCOMPAT' (continuation line 28). DFHCSD DD (line 30) is DISP=SHR so mode is read by the DISP rule, although the utility actually updates the CSD. Line 25 is a JCL SET statement, not a step. In-stream CSD definitions (lines 34-163) not parsed.
